Name: JM Cozy Tabletop Decorations
Author: jawesome9235
Description:
# JM Cozy Tabletop Decorations

Give your farmhouse a little more personality with 35 cozy tabletop decorations: flowers, sweet treats, vintage treasures and small animal figurines. Each item uses a detailed 64×64 pixel-art sprite and fits a 1×1 tile footprint.

##Latest Update

[b]New in v1.1:[/b] 
- To keep shop and catalogue menus uncluttered, this mod’s items now appear exclusively in [color=#ffff00][b]J[/b][/color][b][color=#ffff00]M Furniture Catalogue[/color][/b] when it is installed, instead of Robin’s shop and Furniture Catalogue. 
- [b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue[/color] is optional;[/b] without it, the items remain available through Robin as before. 
- You can purchase [b][color=#ffff00]JM Furniture Catalogue [/color][/b]from Robin’s shop for [b]40,000g[/b].
[color=#ffff00][b]JM Furniture Catalogue: [/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53708[/color]


## Features

- 35 new decorative furniture items with warm colors and a Stardew-inspired pixel-art style.
- Place decorations on empty tables or on the floor.
- Get every item free from Robin's Furniture Catalogue, or buy individual pieces from Robin's shop.
- Automatic names in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese and Korean.
- English fallback for other game languages. All names keep the JM- prefix.
- One installation folder, with artwork, translations and code included together.

## What's included?

Flowers and greenery: Glass Vase, Glass Terrarium, Daisy Ceramic Vase, Sunflower Basket, Lavender Glass Bottle, Miniature Olive Tree and Water-Grown Hyacinth.

Food and drinks: Ceramic Tea Set, Coffee Tray, Strawberry Cake Plate, Croissant Breakfast Basket, Glass Cookie Jar, Honey Jar and Dipper, Lemonade Pitcher, Cheese Platter, Jam Jar Set, Hot Chocolate Mug and Glass Candy Jar.

Cozy objects and keepsakes: Cream Table Lamp, Scented Candle, Vintage Radio, Decorative Books, Miniature Model Ship, Vintage Telephone, Wooden Mantel Clock, Brass Alarm Clock, Miniature Gramophone, Brass Globe, Wooden Music Box, Miniature Birdcage and Moon and Stars Ornament.

Animal figurines: Ceramic Cat, Ceramic Rabbit, Wooden Bear Carving and Ceramic Fox.

## Requirements

Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1.10 or later. No Content Patcher, Custom Furniture or ScaleUp dependency is required.

## Installation

1. Install SMAPI if you don't already have it.
2. Close the game and download the main file.
3. Extract the single JM Table Decorations folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

To update from an earlier version, replace the old JM Table Decorations folder. Keep only one copy installed. Existing item IDs and artwork are preserved in version 1.2.0.

## Getting and placing your decorations

Open Robin's Furniture Catalogue to claim the items for free. This is the furniture catalogue, rather than Pierre's wallpaper and flooring catalogue. Individual items are also available in Robin's shop.

Hold a decoration and use the normal placement action on an empty table. The mod follows the game's standard one-display-item-per-table rule. Remove the existing display item first if the table is occupied. You can also place these decorations on the floor.

## Languages

Names follow the game's selected language automatically. Seven languages are included in the same download: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Japanese and Korean. Unsupported languages and missing translation entries fall back to English.

## Compatibility and scope

This mod adds its own furniture IDs and preserves the original shop stock. Content registration and drawing are handled by one SMAPI mod. It draws its 64×64 artwork directly, so ScaleUp is unnecessary. Compatibility with every furniture or rendering mod has not been tested.

These are static decorations. Food items are decorative; lamps, candles, clocks, the radio, the gramophone and the music box do not add light, music or other interactive functions. Each item has one orientation.

Before uninstalling, remove these custom decorations from your save and make a backup.
